name: Ebola & haemorrhagic fevers
summary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak reached 11,197 confirmed cases by 11 Nov; WHO reports 400–500 new cases a week
state: ECDC reported on 13 Nov 11,197 confirmed cases and 5,471 deaths in DR Congo to 11 Nov, with community transmission in eight provinces; Kenya has nine cases and Uganda's outbreak has ended (ECDC). CDC's 15 Nov update counts 11,285 confirmed cases and 5,509 deaths across five countries to 12 Nov (CDC). WHO's Africa office said on 15 Nov that 400–500 new cases are reported weekly (WHO). Cases far exceed the 1,000 Alert line.
for_you: Risk outside the affected region remains low, according to WHO. Travellers to DR Congo, Uganda or Kenya should follow FCDO travel advice and NHS fit for travel guidance; anyone unwell after return should call NHS 111 before attending.
rubric_hit: More than 1,000 cases: 11,197 confirmed in DR Congo to 11 Nov (ECDC) = Alert
basis_detail: WHO, Africa CDC and ECDC case counts
basis_by: WHO, Africa CDC and ECDC case counts

sources.title: WHO Africa — Six months on, accessing hard-to-reach communities key to halting Ebola outbreak

why: Ebola, Marburg and similar viruses kill a large share of those infected; outbreaks that reach cities or cross borders can overwhelm health systems.
drivers: Surveillance and contact tracing, vaccine availability (none licensed for some strains), conflict, cross-border travel, health-worker infections.

rubric.alert: More than 1,000 cases, or spread to a new country in the past 30 days.
rubric.watch: An active outbreak contained within one country, or fewer than 1,000 cases.
rubric.normal: No active Ebola/Marburg outbreak, or outbreaks declining with no new countries affected in 60 days.
